title: Requirement-by-requirement status, 2026-11-19 (namespaced audit)
rule: A row is 'done' only when every artifact it names exists on disk AND this pass verified the evidence it cites. 'partial' names the gap. A row whose artifact does not exist is downgraded to 'claimed-but-missing' by the script itself, so this register cannot claim work that is not in the repository. This is a second opinion beside data/content/requirements.json (scripts/build_requirements.py), not a replacement: the two are published side by side so a reader can see where they agree.

rows.requirement: Scheduled job refreshes schedule, standings, team stats and injury report for each rolling slate, then rebuilds only after freshness and provenance gates pass
rows.evidence_2026_11_19: verifier ran the same gate logic the UI shows; the gate is BLOCKED on freshness and provenance, and the bet surface is closed because of it (data/content/verify_2026-11-19_d66245d4.json)
rows.gap: the scheduled run still promotes an injury pointer that is not the newest archived edition (open item X6 on this board, unchanged by this seat)

rows.evidence_2026_11_19: 222 rows, 222 Final, 0 quarter-sum failures; every one of the 18 finished November days matches the official month grid exactly (rows.results_feed)
rows.gap: none found in this pass

rows.requirement: Store every injury PDF with its timestamp and diff consecutive reports to detect status changes

rows.gap: none found in this pass

rows.requirement: Two independent estimators; publish their disagreement as the primary confidence signal, blend underneath
rows.evidence_2026_11_19: the estimators page exists and the picks page prints disagreement as its headline
rows.gap: this seat did not re-derive the two estimators; that is a model task, not a verification task

rows.requirement: Pin home-court advantage to the measured home-win rate instead of fitting it
rows.evidence_2026_11_19: measured home win rate 0.5023 -> HCA 0.09 points, applied on every one of the 26 horizon rows (home_court_applied: true)
rows.gap: the pin is applied, but the measured rate is 0.5023 while an independent read of the standings gives 111 home wins in 221 games (0.5023) - consistent

rows.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per team and refuse to publish a strategy leaning on a team outside the noise band
rows.evidence_2026_11_19: data/derived/strategies.json carries a noise_band_refusal block per strategy and the refusal test suite passes (13 test files, 0 failing)
rows.gap: none found in this pass

rows.evidence_2026_11_19: rest and travel rows exist and render
